purpose: The registry's own validator is stubbed to a no-op: the loop body of validateProductSemanticRelations never runs, so every input validates as { ok: true, diagnostics: [] }. Under the closed probe set RELATION_RULE_PROBES none of the 11 declared relation rules is ever reported, so rulesEvaluated can no longer claim them: the gate records only its 8 source rules, rejects the report with report-field-missing on rulesEvaluated and exits 1. This is the negative CONTRACT-HARDENING.md section 12.2 item 1 said the constant rulesEvaluated of C3/C4 could not provide.
